question: For five binary verifier receipts and a threshold of three, how does domain-deduplicated quorum admission trade false PASS/FAIL against abstention compared with raw counting, under an exact finite model?
scope: Exhaustive synthetic contract analysis only; no real verifier, system, model, tool, latency, cost, deployment probability, or security claim.

universe.domain_partitions: all set partitions of five verifier identities
universe.domain_vote_assignments: all binary PASS/FAIL assignments constant within each dependency domain

policy_contract.DECLARED_INDEPENDENT: Count distinct declared independence labels by vote, threshold 3; base labels are truthful; adversarial probe forges labels.
policy_contract.DEPENDENCY_AWARE: Count distinct verified dependency domains by vote, threshold 3; if neither side reaches 3 return UNCERTAIN.
policy_contract.FAIL_CLOSED_UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY: Return UNCERTAIN if any receipt lacks dependency metadata; otherwise same as DEPENDENCY_AWARE.
